steps.title: Welcome to Text2trade!
steps.content: This is your AI-powered trading strategy builder. Let's take a quick tour of what you can do.

steps.title: Your Strategies
steps.content: All your trading strategies live here. We've created 3 demo strategies for you to explore.

steps.title: Build a Strategy
steps.content: Click here to start a conversation with AI. Just describe what you want to trade and how.

steps.title: Screen & Backtest
steps.content: Use the Screener to find stocks matching your criteria. Backtest your strategies against real historical data.

steps.title: Paper Trade
steps.content: Happy with backtest results? Deploy to paper trading to simulate real execution with virtual money.

steps.title: Track Performance
steps.content: The Performance Tracker shows your cumulative P&L, best strategies, and improvement trends over time.

steps.title: Your Demo Capital
steps.content: You have 10,000 in demo money. Use it to practice without any risk. Switch to real mode when you're ready.

steps.title: You're All Set!
steps.content: Start exploring. Build your first strategy or check out the demo ones we've created for you. You can restart this tour anytime from the sidebar.
